description: Within-vehicle belt risk ratio of death (driver / right-front pairs) within strata of the driver's speeding, BAC, crash type and time
population: FARS 2016-2024 light passenger vehicles with one eligible driver and one right-front passenger (Phase-1 eligibility)
method: Evans double-pair comparison, inverse-variance combination of four components; crash-cluster percentile bootstrap (1000 replicates); heterogeneity z-test on the log ratio of the two strata's RRs with the SE from a joint crash-cluster bootstrap of both strata (they can share crashes; seed offset +2)
